name: device_audit_events
description: Append-only device lifecycle audit: pairing, renaming, rotation, moves, unlinking, erasure confirmation and recorded resets.
lifecycle: Inserted in the transaction of the change it records; never updated or deleted by the runtime. Retention follows PH-13.

columns.Meaning: Company the event belongs to; immutable (tenant key).

columns.Null meaning: The device itself confirmed its erasure.

columns.Meaning: Membership through which the person acted.
columns.Null meaning: The device itself confirmed its erasure.

columns.Meaning: Event name, such as device.paired or device.unlinked.
Allowlisted details such as branch IDs and rotations; never codes, hashes or network addresses.

constraints.Purpose: A person and their membership are recorded together or not at all.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (actor_principal_id) REFERENCES principals(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The actor is an existing principal.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, actor_membership_id) REFERENCES memberships(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The acting membership belongs to the same company.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, device_id) REFERENCES devices(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The device belongs to the same company.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id) REFERENCES companies(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: An event belongs to an existing company.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX device_audit_events_company_id_id_key ON public.device_audit_events USING btree (company_id, id)
constraints.Purpose: Tenant key of device audit events.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE INDEX device_audit_events_device_time_idx ON public.device_audit_events USING btree (company_id, device_id, occurred_at DESC, id DESC)
constraints.Purpose: Lists a device's events newest first.
